_why: The TikTok accounts closest to SavorScout's videos, each checked before joining: active in the last 45 days and mostly posting in our niche (one matching search result proves nothing). compete.py compares each account's hits with its own flops, so the audience is held fixed and the difference is the content. Public creator accounts with 5,000+ followers only. Edit freely: add {"handle", "label", "kind"} after `compete.py validate <handle>`, or set "paused": true to stop following one.
